notes: Reference species. Rock-dwelling. Carries none of the six inversions (Kumar 2025 Fig. 4B; Blumer 2025).
Stands in for the riverine ancestor. Sister to mbuna and nested inside the radiation in whole-genome trees. Carries none of the six inversions.
Inversions on 2, 10, 13 are rare or absent in utaka (Blumer 2025). Both arms of the chr 20 double inversion are homozygous inverted in all benthics (Kumar 2025). 9 and 11 segregate within benthics.
Fixed for the inversions on 9, 11 and 20; not inverted on 2, 10, 13 (Kumar 2025). The 9 and 11 inversions were seen in a de novo D. limnothrissa assembly (Blumer 2025).
Shallow benthic (owner; Kumar 2025). Double inversion on 20 seen in this species (Kumar 2025 Fig. 3). Inversions on 2, 10, 13 are rare or absent in shallow benthics.
Only the left arm of the chr 20 double inversion (20a) is inverted; the 4.1 Mb right arm (20b) is not (Kumar 2025). Ancestral for the other five.
True deep clade (owner). Carries all six inversions (Kumar 2025, three de novo assemblies). The chr 10 inversion is linked to an XY sex-determination system.

Deep benthic (owner); a rocky Aulonocara in Blumer 2025 (owner). Lacks the 2, 10, 13 inversions that most deep benthics carry (Kumar 2025). Malinsky 2018 found it intermediate between shallow and deep benthic.
